# Be'er HaGolah on Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim

באר הגולה על שולחן ערוך אורח חיים

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Be%27er%20HaGolah%20on%20Shulchan%20Arukh%2C%20Orach%20Chayim](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Be%27er%20HaGolah%20on%20Shulchan%20Arukh%2C%20Orach%20Chayim)

ספר ההלכה המקובל והמרכזי ביותר בעולם היהודי. נכתב במאה ה-16.

17th-centrury reference work by Rabbi Moshe Rivkes citing sources for the Shulchan Arukh law's in earlier rabbinic literature.

Sections: Siman-Seif

Location: Halakhah/Shulchan Arukh/Commentary/Be'er HaGolah

Originally from [Sefaria](https://www.sefaria.org) via [TorahLM.org](https://torahlm.org) — see [licensing](https://torahlm.org/sefaria_license).

Version (He): Maginei Eretz: Shulchan Aruch Orach Chaim, Lemberg, 1893 (Segments: 7827)

Version (En): Sefaria Community Translation (Segments: 23)
